Method of Attack: Brute-force attacks on Internet-exposed NAS devices
Encrypting NAS devices with ransomware payloads
Discoverer: QNAP Product Security Incident Response Team (QNAP PSIRT)
Indicators of Compromise: QNAP NAS devices running QTS 4.3.6 and 4.4.1
Affected QNAP models TS-x51 series and TS-x53 series
